title_en: Chinese Science Fiction (12/20): Storm over Blue Whale City
note_en: 整座城市都被巨大的水流推得摇晃起来 combines two patterns: 被 marks the passive ("was pushed by huge currents"), and 得 attaches the result of the verb, 推得摇晃起来 "pushed so that it started to sway." English needs "so...that" or "until" for this, but in Chinese 得 simply links the action to its outcome, as in 他跑得很累 "he ran until he was exhausted."
